question: Does the 5-year (2021-08-01..2026-09-30) per-cell gross direction (house exits, v4 normal sizing) replicate on 2020-01-01..2021-08-01 Binance USDT-M futures bars (data/pre2021)?
data: data/pre2021 (Binance USD-M monthly klines, 5m/15m/1h/4h native, 30m = resample of 5m as research/entry_study/final_signals.py), 6 coins BTC ETH SOL DOGE LTC BCH (XRP present but not in the 5y universe: excluded)
signals: core: locked sweep_lib.compute_signals via research/entry_study/final_signals.load_bars + signal_arrays (read-only import); DS: research/deepseek200/lib_c.entries with BTC context (read-only import); long wins on bars with both sides (as fyds_rerun / paperbot dssig)
window: signal bar time in [2020-01-01, 2021-08-01) and past sweep_lib.warmup_bars(tf) (max 300 bars, 30 days) of each coin series; exits may run into 2021-08 (bars to 2021-08-31)
exits_costs: identical to the 5y verified run: next-bar open + 0.02% slippage, stop 2 x ATR14 of the signal bar, paper v3 ROE ladder (profiles._scan), v4 'normal' sizing (config.v3_settings, $5,000; unsized signals dropped), taker 0.05% x2, slippage 0.02% x2, funding 0.01%/8h constant
metrics: gross R = side*(exit_raw/raw-1)/stop_frac (liquidations excluded, as v3agg); net R = v4n_R; mean and week-clustered t (cluster = ts // 7 days, as v3agg.ct)
expected_sign: sign of the 5y verified gross R in lens/fiveyear/verify3/agg_cells.csv

replication_rules.bh_replication: nominal and BH q <= 0.05 on the one-sided p in the 5y direction, BH over the 23 primary cells
replication_rules.inconclusive: otherwise; read together with the power column (expected t if the true effect equals the 5y estimate)

secondary: all other cells of these strategies and all core-36 x 5 tf / DS-44 x 4 tf cells for a global rank-agreement check (Spearman of 5y gross t vs pre gross t, cells with n>=200 in both)
long/short split (2020-21 was a bull market)
real-funding net R sensitivity from data/orderflow funding
5m-resolution exits for F16_FIB382/500@15m on the recent 5 years (and on pre2021), N23_HA_ST@4h on pre2021
